scope: test-only role-pool idle cleanup, new capability pool pressure test, private decoder semaphore extraction, new password/sanitizer cancellation tests
limitations: New pool pressure test is an in-process router/real SQL and Redis integration case, not a network flood or capacity benchmark.

Healthz is expected to remain200 for auth-only saturation because production readiness checks API/migrations and Redis. It returns503 for API saturation. This must be reported as observed behavior, not complete readiness of every role pool.
Direct begin_authed_as test enforces an outer1second timeout and any error. Exact250ms acquisition timing is a source-established deadline, not a measured250ms bound asserted by this case.

The test holds real connection guards and independently counts pg_stat_activity, but does not measure production waiter-peak or queued demand under load. Reserved consultation admission cannot guarantee clinical200 when shared capability pool is full; the expected controlled503 captures this limitation.

Cancellation tests deterministically abort callers while actual production blocking closures are queued. They prove permit retention until the closure completes and recovery, not actual simultaneous CPU worker occupancy in a network attack.
